note: Paraphrase benchmark. 'said' is how a preacher might put a verse in their own words; 'refs' are the verses it should find (any one counts). Negatives are ordinary sermon speech that must not be matched. Commonly preached verses across the whole Bible, several paraphrase styles, with and without an attribution ('the Bible says...').
